data.title: Marina Pinnacle
data.about:
Marina Pinnacle is a popular skyscraper located in the iconic waterfront community of Dubai Marina. The luxury project of Tiger Properties consists of 276 floors with three levels dedicated for parking. The accommodation options include 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each intricately designed to provide unparalleled comfort and sophistication. Marina Pinnacle by Tiger Properties price starts from AED 800k.

The tower boasts exceptional architectural design, contributing to the iconic skyline of Dubai Marina.The residences also offer stunning views of the marina and Arabian Gulf with lifestyle amenities such as Marina Pinnacle gym, Marina Pinnacle pool, health club and BBQ Area.

Pinnacle Tower Dubai Marina holds a prominent position on Al Sharta Street, in proximity to the Marina 101 building and the Dubai International Marine Club. Moreover, many upscale restaurants, bars and pubs are in proximity to the location.

location_tile.description:
Th luxury tower of Marina Pinnacle building is located in Dubai Marina, a man-made marvel along the Persian Gulf shoreline. This vibrant waterfront district offers a stunning skyline adorned with sleek skyscrapers, luxury residences, including Tiger Marina Pinnacle, and high-end shopping and dining destinations. Boasting a mix of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces, Dubai Marina is a coveted destination for residents and visitors alike, offering a cosmopolitan lifestyle.
